zh: 全部隊注意，停火協議將在五分鐘後生效。重複，五分鐘後。
你這一身傷，還要親自走過去？
說好了，要親眼看它簽下去。
我在上面看著你們兩個老頭，別走散了。
卡爾，戰爭結束以後，你要做什麼？
停下！再往前一步就開火！
上面！有東西從雲裡下來了！
停火？戰爭是生意，而生意……永遠不會停。
被打中了！旋翼受損，我得先撤！
你知道這座城，為什麼燒了十年嗎？
因為每一發子彈，都有人付錢。
同盟、聯合，兩邊的帳單，都寄到奧林。
停火的那一天，就是奧林破產的那一天。
奧林養的狗，也會咬主人。
黑犬……你不是已經死在這條街上了？
三個人，只有一個能活著走出這條街。
愚蠢……停火什麼都改變不了！
停火協議生效倒數，十、九、八……
去找真正該打的仗。奧林還沒倒。
回家吧。我請你們喝一杯——這次是真的。
en: All units: the ceasefire comes into force in five minutes. Repeat, five minutes.
In that state, and you still want to walk it yourself?
I said I’d see it signed with my own eyes.
I’ve got you two old men from up here. Don’t wander off.
Karl, when the war’s over, what will you do?
Halt! One more step and we fire!
We came to see the ceasefire.
Above you! Something’s coming down out of the cloud!
A ceasefire? War is a business, and business... never stops.
I’m hit! Rotor damage, I have to pull out!
Do you know why this city has burned for ten years?
Because every round fired is paid for.
Alliance, Union: both sides’ bills come to Orrin.
...So the ceasefire is bad for business.
The day the guns stop is the day Orrin goes under.
Orrin’s dogs can bite the hand too.
Hound... didn’t you die in this street?
A man who’s died once is the hardest to kill.
Three of us. Only one walks out of this street.
Ron. This time I’m not fighting you.
I’m back! Give me thirty seconds!
To find the war worth fighting. Orrin isn’t finished.
Next time, let’s not be enemies.
Let’s go home. Drinks are on me — for real this time.
